tool.name: Falco
tool.description: An alternative, more performant implementation of FastQC for high throughput sequence quality control
tool.command:
#import re #set input_name_sl = re.sub('[^\w\-\s]', '_', str($input_file.element_identifier))
ln -s '${input_file}' '${input_name_sl}' && falco -o outdir --threads \${GALAXY_SLOTS:-2} #if $contaminants: --contaminants '${contaminants}' #end if
#if $adapters: --adapters '${adapters}' #end if $groups $tiles $dups $adap $kmers #if str($advanced.orig_dups) == "true": --orig-dups #end if $bisulfite #if str($advanced.custom_thresholds.use_custom) == "true": --config '$limits_config' #end if '${input_name_sl}' && cp 'outdir/${input_name_sl}/fastqc_report.html' '$html_file' && cp 'outdir/${input_name_sl}/fastqc_data.txt' '$text_file' && cp 'outdir/${input_name_sl}/summary.txt' '$summary_file'

configfiles.configfile:
#if str($advanced.custom_thresholds.use_custom) == "true" ## Generated from user-specified threshold values ## Module enable/disable (controlled by CLI flags, but required in config) duplication ignore 0 #if str($kmers) == "--kmers" kmer ignore 0 #else kmer ignore 1 #end if n_content ignore 0 overrepresented ignore 0 quality_base ignore 0 sequence ignore 0 gc_sequence ignore 0 quality_sequence ignore 0 #if str($tiles) == "--tiles" tile ignore 0 #else tile ignore 1 #end if sequence_length ignore 0 #if str($adap) == "--no-adap" adapter ignore 1 #else adapter ignore 0 #end if
## Threshold values duplication warn $advanced.custom_thresholds.dup_warn duplication error $advanced.custom_thresholds.dup_error kmer warn $advanced.custom_thresholds.kmer_warn kmer error $advanced.custom_thresholds.kmer_error n_content warn $advanced.custom_thresholds.n_content_warn n_content error $advanced.custom_thresholds.n_content_error overrepresented warn $advanced.custom_thresholds.overrep_warn overrepresented error $advanced.custom_thresholds.overrep_error quality_base_lower warn $advanced.custom_thresholds.quality_base_lower_warn quality_base_lower error $advanced.custom_thresholds.quality_base_lower_error quality_base_median warn $advanced.custom_thresholds.quality_base_median_warn quality_base_median error $advanced.custom_thresholds.quality_base_median_error sequence warn $advanced.custom_thresholds.sequence_warn sequence error $advanced.custom_thresholds.sequence_error gc_sequence warn $advanced.custom_thresholds.gc_sequence_warn gc_sequence error $advanced.custom_thresholds.gc_sequence_error quality_sequence warn $advanced.custom_thresholds.quality_sequence_warn quality_sequence error $advanced.custom_thresholds.quality_sequence_error tile warn $advanced.custom_thresholds.tile_warn tile error $advanced.custom_thresholds.tile_error sequence_length warn $advanced.custom_thresholds.sequence_length_warn sequence_length error $advanced.custom_thresholds.sequence_length_error adapter warn $advanced.custom_thresholds.adapter_warn adapter error $advanced.custom_thresholds.adapter_error #end if

param.name: input_file
param.label: Raw read data from your current history
Contaminant list
param.help: Tab-delimited file with two columns: name and sequence. Replaces falco's default contaminant list.

param.label: Adapter list
param.help: Tab-delimited file with two columns: name and sequence. Replaces falco's default adapter list.

param.label: Group base positions
param.help: Group base positions in plots. Falco 2.0+ reports individual base positions by default; enable this to group positions (equivalent to FastQC's default grouping for reads longer than 50 bp).

param.label: Per-tile quality analysis
param.help: Per-tile sequence quality analysis. Only meaningful for Illumina data with tile information in read headers. Disabled by default because falco 2.0.x can fail on some non-standard read headers.

param.label: Sequence duplication analysis
param.help: Toggle duplication and overrepresented sequences analysis.

param.label: Adapter content analysis
K-mer content analysis
param.help: Toggle k-mer content analysis. Disabled by default.

param.label: Bisulfite sequencing
param.help: Indicate that reads come from whole-genome bisulfite sequencing so falco accounts for the expected increase in T and decrease in C in the base content.

param.label: Use original duplication mode
param.help: Use falco's original (pre-2.0) duplication grading algorithm instead of the new improved one. Only relevant when duplication analysis is enabled.

param.name: use_custom
param.label: Custom warn/error thresholds
param.help: By default falco uses built-in threshold values for each module's WARN/FAIL grades. Enable this to override them with your own values. A configuration file is generated on the fly and passed to falco.

param.name: dup_warn
param.label: Duplication: warn if deduplicated percentage below

param.name: dup_error
param.label: Duplication: error if deduplicated percentage below

param.name: kmer_warn

param.name: kmer_error
param.label: K-mer: error if -log10 p-value above

param.label: N content: warn if percentage of Ns above

param.label: N content: error if percentage of Ns above

param.name: overrep_warn

param.label: Overrepresented sequences: error if proportion above

param.name: quality_base_lower_warn
param.label: Per-base quality: warn if lower quartile below

param.name: quality_base_lower_error
param.label: Per-base quality: error if lower quartile below

param.name: quality_base_median_warn
param.label: Per-base quality: warn if median below

param.name: quality_base_median_error
param.label: Per-base quality: error if median below

param.name: sequence_warn
param.label: Per-base sequence content: warn if max deviation above
param.help: Maximum deviation between A and T or C and G.

param.name: sequence_error
param.label: Per-base sequence content: error if max deviation above

param.name: gc_sequence_warn
param.label: Per-sequence GC content: warn if deviation above
param.help: Maximum deviation between the theoretical and observed distribution.

param.name: gc_sequence_error
param.label: Per-sequence GC content: error if deviation above

param.name: quality_sequence_warn
param.label: Per-sequence quality: warn if most common phred score below

param.name: quality_sequence_error
param.label: Per-sequence quality: error if most common phred score below

param.name: tile_warn
param.label: Per-tile quality: warn if phred score loss above
param.help: Maximum phred score loss between an individual tile and the average for that base.

param.name: tile_error
param.label: Per-tile quality: error if phred score loss above

param.name: sequence_length_warn
param.label: Sequence length: warn threshold
param.help: Binary flag (0=off, 1=on). Warns if sequences have different lengths.

param.name: sequence_length_error
param.label: Sequence length: error threshold
param.help: Binary flag (0=off, 1=on).Errors if sequences have zero length.

param.name: adapter_warn
param.label: Adapter content: warn if percentage above
param.help: Percentage of reads containing an adapter-associated k-mer.

param.name: adapter_error
param.label: Adapter content: error if percentage above

tool.help:
**What it does**
Falco is a high-speed emulation of the popular FastQC software for quality control of sequencing data. With its superior performance Falco saves computational resources and gives you results faster than FastQC.
The main functions of Falco are very similar to those of FastQC:
- Import of data from FASTQ files (plain or gzip-compressed) - Providing a quick overview to tell you in which areas there may be problems - Summary graphs and tables to quickly assess your data - Export of results to an HTML-based report
The plain text report generated by Falco can be used as a "FastQC" report in MultiQC. Its data is very similar, though not 100% identical, to that generated by FastQC on the same inputs.
-----
**Inputs and outputs**
The wrapper accepts a Galaxy FASTQ or FASTQ.gz dataset as the input read file to check.
Optionally you can provide:
- a **Contaminant list** - a tab-delimited file with two columns (name and sequence) that replaces falco's default contaminant list - an **Adapter list** - a tab-delimited file with two columns (name and sequence) that replaces falco's default adapter list
The tool produces three outputs:
- an **HTML report** with interactive plots - a **raw data** text file (usable as input to MultiQC) - a **summary** text file listing the pass/warn/fail status of each module
-----
**Module toggles**
You can enable or disable individual analysis modules:
- **Per-tile quality analysis** - only meaningful for Illumina data with tile information in read headers - **Sequence duplication analysis** - duplication and overrepresented sequences - **Adapter content analysis** - adapter content detection - **K-mer content analysis** - disabled by default
In the **Advanced options** section you can also switch to falco's original (pre-2.0) duplication grading algorithm with **Use original duplication mode**.
-----
**Custom thresholds**
In the **Advanced options** section you can override the default WARN/FAIL threshold values for each module's grading. When enabled, a configuration file is generated on the fly from your specified values and passed to falco. All threshold values use the same units as FastQC's `limits.txt` configuration file.
-----
**Notes on BAM/SAM input**
Falco 2.0.0 was a complete rewrite. BAM and SAM input are currently unreliable in the 2.0.x releases (see upstream issue [#45](https://github.com/smithlabcode/falco/issues/45)), so this wrapper only accepts FASTQ/FASTQ.gz input for now. BAM/SAM support will be re-enabled once the upstream issue is resolved.
